description: x.com panels: only the focus report, their unread counts, the app shortcuts (switch panel, show/hide top bar, ...), reading their key bindings (the app's and the moved X keys) and the X screen rules (data only), opening a pasted X link in this panel after asking, sending an X link to another panel, a log line when the panel was stuck on X's loading screen and the post capture (screenshots of this panel only, then the preview). No core permissions, no account, layout or settings commands.
